answer: Faking thousands of identities means funding every bond and sustaining real interactive proofs through the whole voyage, so costs volume linearly with each fake node while honest single agents pay once. Each agent must stake a bond locked until a random dawn, and peers exchange a signed whisper of liveness during that window. Colluding rings get slashed when any member fails the liveness whisper, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
